headline: Copper prices decline for fifth consecutive session
summary: Copper prices on the London Metal Exchange fell 3.6% to $12,763 per metric ton, marking the metal's longest weekly losing streak in two years.
why: Copper is a critical industrial metal often viewed as a barometer for global economic health, particularly in manufacturing and construction sectors.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: The market price of copper is directly reported as falling.
